CheckTitle: Supabase Auth rotates refresh tokens on every use
Description: **Supabase Auth** is assessed for **refresh token rotation**. With rotation, each refresh issues a new token and invalidates the old one, so replaying a captured token is detected.
Risk: Without rotation, a refresh token stolen from local storage, logs or a device backup **keeps minting access tokens** until the user signs out everywhere, enabling persistent silent account access.

Code.Other:
1. Open the Supabase Dashboard and select the project
2. Go to Authentication > Sessions (or Settings)
3. Enable Refresh token rotation and keep the reuse interval short

Recommendation.Text: Enable refresh token rotation and a short reuse interval; pair it with session timeboxing for sensitive apps.
